remarks: Charming Colonial in Prime Location: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2.1-bath Colonial, perfectly situated in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods-just moments from schools, train, and town.  Offering a seamless floor plan ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, this home features a thoughtfully renovated gourmet kitchen with a center island, premium finishes, and plenty of storage. The kitchen opens to a bright and inviting family room with sliding doors that lead to a spacious deck and a private, fenced-in yard-perfect for outdoor gatherings, play, or relaxation.  Imagine spending summer nights on the front covered porch, taking in the charm of the neighborhood and enjoying the peaceful surroundings.  With classic curb appeal, modern updates, and an unbeatable location, this home is not to be missed!
